turns.prompt: Add a way to run the game locally on windows using liveserver in VS Code
turns.reply:
You can now run the game on Windows with VS Code and the Live Server extension. I haven't tried it on Windows or in Live Server myself, so your first run is the test. The change is in PR [fischerq/ludumdare60#14](https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/14).

- **`.vscode/extensions.json`:** VS Code suggests installing Live Server when you open the folder.
- **`.vscode/settings.json`:** Live Server serves the whole repo on port 5500. Other devices on your Wi-Fi can open it too. It doesn't reload the page when only docs or the making-of log change.
- **README:** a short "Windows: VS Code + Live Server" section with the steps.

**To test:**
1. Open the repo folder in VS Code and install Live Server when it suggests it.
2. Open `index.html` and click **Go Live** in the status bar. The game should open in your browser and reload whenever you save a file.
3. On your phone, on the same Wi-Fi, open `http://<your-pc-ip>:5500/`. If Windows Firewall asks, allow VS Code on private networks, or the phone won't connect.

Plan usage is at 1% of the 5-hour limit and 17% of the weekly limit.
